LightningComponentBundle.description: AI-powered assistant for meeting summaries and wealth plan structuring.

property.name: componentTitle
property.label: Component Title
property.description: Heading shown at the top of the component and on the launcher card. Leave blank to use the default, 'Advisor Assistant'.

property.name: componentSubtitle
property.label: Component Subtitle
property.description: Smaller line under the title. Leave blank to use the default, 'AI-powered meeting & wealth plan structuring'.

property.name: backgroundColor
property.label: Background Color
property.description: CSS colour or gradient for the component background. Accepts any valid CSS background value, e.g. '#f0f9ff' or 'linear-gradient(...)'.

property.name: modalMode
property.label: Open as Modal Overlay
property.description: When enabled, the component shows as a compact launcher card that opens in a full-screen overlay.

property.name: hideBetaBadge
property.label: Hide Beta Badge
property.description: Hides the BETA badge next to the title.

property.name: flowApiName
property.label: Wealth Plan Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched Flow that returns structured wealth plan JSON. Required.

property.name: meetingSummaryFlowApiName
property.label: Meeting Summary Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched Flow that returns the meeting summary as text or HTML. Inputs: eventId, accountId, documentId1-3, additionalContext, meetingType, hasTodos.

property.name: regenerateSummaryFlowApiName
property.label: Regenerate Summary Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched Flow for regenerating a summary with advisor instructions. Inputs: currentSummary (Text), instructions (Text), documentId (Text). Output: generatedResponse (Text).

property.name: saveSummaryFlowApiName
property.label: Save Summary Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched Flow that saves a MeetingNote__c in the background (no flow navigation). Inputs: noteId, noteHtml, noteMarkdown, briefHtml, briefMarkdown, eventId, published (Boolean), meetingType, deleteNote (Boolean). Output: savedNoteId (Text).

property.name: versionHistoryFlowApiName
property.label: Version History Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched Flow fired when an event is selected. Input: EventId (Text). Output: MeetingNoteVersions (Collection of MeetingNoteVersion__c) with Id, Name, Status__c, DateActive__c, Note__c, BriefSummary__c.

property.name: createVersionFlowApiName
property.label: Create Version Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched Flow used when saving or publishing an edit to an already-published note. Creates a MeetingNoteVersion__c and repoints the parent MeetingNote__c, so published history is never overwritten. Same inputs as Save Summary Flow. Output: savedNoteId (Text).

property.name: saveTodosFlowApiName
property.label: Save To-Do's Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched Flow that creates Task records from accepted action items. Inputs: TodosJson (Text), EventId (Text), WhoId (Text). Output: SaveResult (Text, optional).

property.name: saveInternalNotesFlowApiName
property.label: Save Internal Notes Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched Flow that saves advisor-private internal notes to MeetingNote__c.Internal_Notes__c, independently of the meeting summary. Inputs: noteId (Text, blank to create), eventId (Text), internalNotes (Text). Output: savedNoteId (Text) — the flow must create the MeetingNote__c and link it to the Event when noteId is blank, and return its Id.

property.name: saveFileToEventFlowApiName
property.label: Save File to Event Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched Flow invoked when an advisor saves an uploaded file to the event record. Inputs: ContentDocumentId (Text), EventId (Text).

property.name: wealthPlanSaveFlowApiName
property.label: Wealth Plan Save Flow API Name
property.description: Autolaunched Flow that receives typed SObject collections (GoalsToCreate, AssetsToCreate, etc.) and performs all Wealth Plan DML. When set, saving is delegated to this subflow instead of the parent screen flow.

property.name: inputWhoId
property.label: Who ID (Contact / Lead)
property.description: WhoId of the Contact or Lead to link to saved Task records. Pass the Event's WhoId.

property.name: briefEnabled
property.label: Show 'At a Glance' Brief
property.description: Shows a collapsible 'At a Glance' section above the meeting summary when the Flow returns a brief.

property.name: briefOpenByDefault
property.label: Brief Open by Default
property.description: Starts the 'At a Glance' section expanded instead of collapsed.

property.name: showEditTracking
property.label: Show AI Edited Badge
property.description: Marks wealth-plan rows the advisor has changed since the AI proposed them.

property.name: showExpandCollapseAll
property.label: Show Expand/Collapse All
property.description: Shows the expand-all / collapse-all control above the wealth-plan review sections.

property.name: showDetailedStats
property.label: Show Detailed Stats
property.description: Adds locked-row and error counts to the wealth-plan stats bar.

property.name: showDiscardSection
property.label: Show Discard Section
property.description: Allows discarding a whole wealth-plan section from the review grid.

property.name: showRegenerateSection
property.label: Show Regenerate Section
property.description: Allows regenerating a single wealth-plan section.

property.name: showScrollToError
property.label: Show Scroll to Error
property.description: Shows a control that jumps to the first row failing validation.

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record ID
property.description: Id of the household or record the screen is running against. Stamped onto new Milestone and Greeting records, and used as the target for file uploads.

property.name: inputWhoId
property.label: Who ID (Contact / Lead)
property.description: WhoId of the Contact or Lead to link to saved Task records. Pass the Event's WhoId.

property.name: inputPrimaryMember
property.label: Primary Member (single record)
property.description: The household's primary member. Used as the default owner on new wealth-plan records and passed as accountId to the AI Flows. Preferred over Primary Member ID.

property.name: inputPrimaryMemberId
property.label: Primary Member ID (legacy)
property.description: Legacy alternative to Primary Member — supply only if the record itself is unavailable. Ignored when Primary Member is set.

property.name: inputWealthPlanId
property.label: Existing Wealth Plan ID
property.description: Id of an existing wealth plan for this household, if one exists. Non-blank tells the component the household already has a plan.

property.name: inputEvents
property.label: Meeting Events
property.description: Default list of Event records to choose from. The component starts loading automatically — no separate loading flag needed. Shown under the 'Default' range option.

property.name: inputEventsLast3Months
property.label: Meeting Events — Last 3 Months
property.description: Optional. Events from the last 3 months. Populate to offer a 'Last 3 months' option in the event picker; leave empty to hide that option.

property.name: inputEventsLast6Months
property.label: Meeting Events — Last 6 Months
property.description: Optional. Events from the last 6 months. Populate to offer a 'Last 6 months' option in the event picker; leave empty to hide that option.

property.name: inputEventsLast12Months
property.label: Meeting Events — Last 12 Months
property.description: Optional. Events from the last 12 months. Populate to offer a 'Last 12 months' option in the event picker; leave empty to hide that option.

property.name: inputEventsAll
property.label: Meeting Events — All
property.description: Optional. All events for this household, with no date limit. Populate to offer an 'All' option in the event picker; leave empty to hide that option.

property.name: inputMeetingNotes
property.label: Meeting Notes
property.description: MeetingNote__c records matched to events via the Event.MeetingNote__c lookup. Query Id, Note__c, NoteMarkdown__c, Published__c, Brief_Summary__c.

property.name: inputTasks
property.label: Tasks (for context selection)
property.description: Existing Task records the advisor can tick to feed as extra context into generation. Query Id, Subject, Status, ActivityDate, Description.

property.name: inputArtifacts
property.label: Meeting Artifacts
property.description: Meeting_Artifact__c records linked to events via Event.MeetingArtifacts__c. These group the files attached to a meeting.

property.name: inputContentDocumentLinks
property.label: Content Document Links
property.description: Join between artifacts and files. Query ContentDocumentId and LinkedEntityId. Flow cannot traverse to ContentDocument fields, so pass Content Documents separately as well.

property.name: inputContentDocuments
property.label: Content Documents
property.description: Display metadata for the linked files. Query Id, Title and FileType.

property.name: inputHouseholdMembers
property.label: Household Members
property.description: Accounts offered in the owner dropdowns on wealth-plan rows (Primary Owner, Account).

property.name: inputCompanies
property.label: Company Accounts
property.description: Accounts offered in the 'Company Owned' dropdown on Company Ownership rows.

property.name: inputPersons
property.label: Person Accounts
property.description: Person accounts offered in the 'Company Owner' dropdown on Company Ownership rows.

property.name: inputExistingGoals
property.label: Existing Goals
property.description: FinServ__FinancialGoal__c records already on the household.

property.name: inputExistingIncomes
property.label: Existing Incomes
property.description: FF_Income__c records already on the household.

property.name: inputExistingAssets
property.label: Existing Assets & Liabilities
property.description: FinServ__AssetsAndLiabilities__c records already on the household.

property.name: inputExistingMilestones
property.label: Existing Milestones
property.description: Household_Milestones__c records already on the household.

property.name: inputExistingOwnerships
property.label: Existing Ownerships
property.description: Company_Ownership__c records already on the household.

property.name: inputExistingSustainability
property.label: Existing Sustainability Preferences
property.description: SustainabilityPreferences__c records already on the household.

property.name: inputExistingGreetings
property.label: Existing Personal Greetings
property.description: FF_PersonalGreeting__c records already on the household.

property.name: outputSelectedEventId
property.label: Selected Event ID
property.description: Id of the currently selected event. Use after a Create Records on New Meeting Note to set Event.MeetingNote__c to the new note's Id.

property.name: outputMeetingSummary
property.label: Meeting Summary (HTML)
property.description: The meeting summary as HTML, as currently shown to the advisor.

property.name: outputNoteMarkdown
property.label: Meeting Summary (Markdown)
property.description: Markdown mirror of the meeting summary, for consumption by the client-facing web app.

property.name: outputMeetingType
property.label: Meeting Type
property.description: The meeting category the advisor selected: 'whiteboard', 'status', 'annual', or blank.

property.name: outputHasTodos
property.label: To-Do's Requested
property.description: True when the advisor asked for action items alongside the summary.

property.name: outputMeetingNote
property.label: Meeting Note (for Update)
property.description: Populated when the selected event already has a MeetingNote__c. Contains Id plus the note fields. Use in an Update Records element. Mutually exclusive with New Meeting Note.

property.name: outputMeetingNoteToCreate
property.label: New Meeting Note (for Create)
property.description: Populated when the selected event has no MeetingNote__c. Contains the note fields but no Id. Use in a Create Records element, then set Event.MeetingNote__c using Selected Event ID. Mutually exclusive with Meeting Note.

property.name: outputNoteIdToDelete
property.label: Meeting Note Id to Delete (deprecated)
property.description: Deprecated — retained for backwards compatibility with existing flow versions. Deletion now happens through the Save Summary Flow's deleteNote flag.

property.name: outputSummary
property.label: Wealth Plan Summary (HTML)
property.description: Prose summary the AI returned alongside the structured wealth plan.
